methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper presents a review on the predictive maintenance approaches, methods and tools in manufacturing systems and proposes an integrated predictive maintenance platform.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper proposes a predictive-maintenance platform (data acquisition and analysis, knowledge management, and a sustainability maintenance dashboard) and reviews predictive-maintenance/prognostics methods. Energy and environmental performance indicators appear only incidentally, as dashboard-visualisation outputs and as maintenance-planning optimisation criteria (energy costs, energy efficiency). No EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement or baseline model is identified or characterised: no measured/normalised energy quantity with variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach. Ineligible per v2.3 (tool/software without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content; incidental EnPI mention).

paper_type.evidence_quote: proposes an integrated predictive maintenance platform. This platform consists of three pillars, namely data acquisition and analysis, knowledge management, and a sustainability maintenance dashboard.

stage1.notes: ARIMA/SDF models here target equipment degradation, RUL and fault detection, not energy performance. Sector is general manufacturing/production systems (not a closed continuous-process sector). Review is of maintenance methods, not EnPI/EnB models, so borderline_review flag not set.
